title: Pillion: Voice Co-Pilot for Riders
tagline: A hands-free Hindi and English voice co-pilot that acts on the phone and keeps riders safe.
description: A native Android app for delivery and bike-taxi riders: an Agora Conversational AI agent talks in Hindi, English or Hinglish, calls tools that act on the phone over RTM (ETA, SMS, calls, answering incoming calls), speaks first with the speak and think APIs for crash checks, and hands the line to family through the Web SDK during an SOS.
author: jatinvats123
